notes: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?r) AS ?records) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients) (ROUND(AVG(?d)) AS ?avg_days) (MIN(?d) AS ?min_days) (MAX(?d) AS ?max_days) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?r a sphn:MedicalProcedure . ?r sphn:hasStartDateTime ?start ; sphn:hasEndDateTime ?end . } FILTER(?end >= ?start) BIND(bif:datediff("day", ?start, ?end) AS ?d) }

request: What are the top 10 most frequent ICD-10 codes for Chronic diseases of the lower respiratory organs (J40-J47) on billed diagnosis records, including patient and record counts?
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?code (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?r) AS ?records) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?r a sphn:BilledDiagnosis ; sphn:hasCode ?c . ?c rdf:type icd-10-gm:J40-J47 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") . ?c a ?concept . } FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?concept), STR(icd-10-gm:))) BIND(REPLACE(STR(?concept), "^.*/", "") AS ?code) } GROUP BY ?code ORDER BY DESC(?patients) LIMIT 10
request_template_version: Lists the 10 most frequent codes under Chronische Krankheiten der unteren Atemwege (ICD-10-GM J40-J47, including sub-codes) on billed diagnosis records, with the number of patients and records for each.
notes: SELECT ?code (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?r) AS ?records) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?r a sphn:BilledDiagnosis ; sphn:hasCode ?c . ?c isa icd-10-gm:J40-J47 . ?c a ?concept . } FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?concept), STR(icd-10-gm:))) BIND(REPLACE(STR(?concept), "^.*/", "") AS ?code) } GROUP BY ?code ORDER BY DESC(?patients) LIMIT 10

request: How many patients have upper respiratory diseases or cholera on their bill, how many list it as the main problem, and what percentage is that?
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?principal) AS ?patients_principal) (ROUND(1000.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ?principal) / COUNT(DISTINCT ?g)) / 10 AS ?principal_pct) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?r a sphn:BilledDiagnosis ; sphn:hasCode ?r_c . { ?r_c rdf:type icd-10-gm:J30-J39 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") } UNION { ?r_c rdf:type icd-10-gm:A00 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") } } OPTIONAL { GRAPH ?g { ?r sphn:hasRank sphn-individual:Principal . } BIND(?g AS ?principal) } }

PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?principal) AS ?patients_principal) (ROUND(1000.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ?principal) / COUNT(DISTINCT ?g)) / 10 AS ?principal_pct) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?r a sphn:BilledDiagnosis ; sphn:hasCode ?r_c . ?r_c rdf:type icd-10-gm:I10.9 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") . } OPTIONAL { GRAPH ?g { ?r sphn:hasRank sphn-individual:Principal . } BIND(?g AS ?principal) } }
request_template_version: Counts patients with a billed diagnosis coded as Essential hypertension, unspecified (ICD-10-GM I10.9, including sub-codes), how many of them have it as the principal one, and that share as a percentage.
notes: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?principal) AS ?patients_principal) (ROUND(1000.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ?principal) / COUNT(DISTINCT ?g)) / 10 AS ?principal_pct) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?r a sphn:BilledDiagnosis ; sphn:hasCode ?r_c . ?r_c isa icd-10-gm:I10.9 . } OPTIONAL { GRAPH ?g { ?r sphn:hasRank sphn-individual:Principal . } BIND(?g AS ?principal) } }

request: How many patients with a diagnosis of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia (ICD-10-C92.0) and a documented antimicrobial susceptibility result showing 'Resistant' were born in the year 1955?
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
PREFIX snomed: <http://snomed.info/id/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g {
    ?patient a sphn:Patient .
    
    # Filter for birth year
    FILTER(YEAR(?birthDate) = 1955)
    ?patient sphn-individual:hasBirthDate ?birthDate .
    
    # Link to Tumor Stage Assessment with Leukaemia code
    ?event a sphn:TumorStageAssessmentEvent .
    ?event sphn:hasSubjectPseudoIdentifier ?patient .
    ?assessment sphn:hasAssessment ?diag .
    ?diag sphn:hasCode ?code .
    ?code rdf:type icd-10-gm:C92 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") .
    
    # Link to Antimicrobial Susceptibility Result
    ?suscept a sphn:AntimicrobialSusceptibilityResult .
    ?suscept sphn:hasSubjectPseudoIdentifier ?patient .
    ?suscept sphn:hasCode ?resistCode .
    ?resistCode rdf:type snomed:30714006 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global")
  }
}
request_template_version: How many patients with a diagnosis of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia (ICD-10-C92.0) and a documented antimicrobial susceptibility result showing 'Resistant' were born in the year 1955?
notes: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?count) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?patient a sphn:Patient . # Filter for birth year FILTER(YEAR(?birthDate) = 1955) ?patient sphn-individual:hasBirthDate ?birthDate . # Link to Tumor Stage Assessment with Leukaemia code ?event a sphn:TumorStageAssessmentEvent . ?event sphn:hasSubjectPseudoIdentifier ?patient . ?assessment sphn:hasAssessment ?diag . ?diag sphn:hasCode ?code . ?code isa icd-10-gm:C92 . # Link to Antimicrobial Susceptibility Result ?suscept a sphn:AntimicrobialSusceptibilityResult . ?suscept sphn:hasSubjectPseudoIdentifier ?patient . ?suscept sphn:hasCode ?resistCode . ?resistCode isa snomed:30714006 } }
